mapper.sql: select r.receipt_id,r.receipt_no,r.receipt_type,r.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_name,r.supplier_name, r.receipt_date,r.status,r.total_qty,r.create_by,r.create_time,r.update_by,r.update_time,r.remark from wms_receipt r left join wms_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id=r.warehouse_id
mapper.select: select r.receipt_id,r.receipt_no,r.receipt_type,r.warehouse_id,r.supplier_name,r.receipt_date,r.status,r.total_qty, r.create_by,r.create_time,r.update_by,r.update_time,r.remark from wms_receipt r where r.receipt_id=#{receiptId} for update

select l.line_id,l.receipt_id,l.item_id,i.item_code,i.item_name,i.specification,i.unit,l.location_id, p.location_code,p.location_name,l.batch_no,l.production_date,l.expiry_date,l.planned_qty,l.received_qty from wms_receipt_line l left join wms_item i on i.item_id=l.item_id left join wms_location p on p.location_id=l.location_id where l.receipt_id=#{receiptId} order by l.line_id
mapper.delete: delete from wms_receipt where receipt_id=#{receiptId} and status='DRAFT'
mapper.update: update wms_receipt set status='COMPLETED',total_qty=#{totalQty},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where receipt_id=#{receiptId} and status='DRAFT'
